items.name: Bottonfly
items.summary: Massive insects of the muddwood regions of Eastlandia, central to casterway societies for food, dyes and poisons.

attributes.anatomy: Rust-coloured, eight legs, four undersized wings that drone in flight.
attributes.biologicalTraits: It is a close relative of its Westlandia cousin, the thorinfly, and laypersons often mistake the two. Neither is found on the Boundless Plain.
attributes.domestication: The bottonfly was famously domesticated by Antin Forin, the third potentate of the Archane Order.

items.name: Sunder Whale
items.summary: Follows the current along Eastlandia's coast; no one has seen where it goes.
